concepts.learning_objective: Check whether two ratios are proportional using cross-multiplication.
Find a missing term so that two ratios are proportional.
Explain what the representative fraction (RF) on a map shows.
Convert between map distance and geographical distance using a map ratio.

topics.title: Ratios with more than two terms

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret a ratio with more than two terms and state when two such ratios are proportional.
Scale every term of a multi-term ratio by the same factor to keep a mixture the same.

topics.title: Dividing a whole in a given ratio

concepts.learning_objective: Divide a quantity in a ratio with two or more terms using x × a / (a + b + c + ...).
Find triangle angles from a ratio and decide whether sides in a ratio can form a triangle.

topics.title: A slice of the pie: pie charts

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the central angle of each sector of a pie chart by dividing 360° in the data's ratio.
Read quantities from the sector angles of a pie chart.
Distinguish pairs of quantities in inverse proportion from those in direct proportion.
Use the relation xy = k for quantities in inverse proportion.

topics.title: Solving inverse proportion and work problems

concepts.learning_objective: Solve word problems on workers, provisions and arrangements using inverse proportion.
Find the time taken when two agents work together by adding their work per hour.
